title: Your forgotten jacket is “held by customs”
scenario: A hotel says it mailed your forgotten jacket home. Two days later, a text claims customs is holding the parcel and asks for a small duty plus your passport number to release it.

answers.A: Contact the carrier using its official contact details and ask what information customs legitimately needs.
answers.B: Pay the small duty first because you are genuinely expecting a parcel, then provide ID only if the tracking updates.
answers.C: Use the tracking number from the hotel and the carrier’s official site/app to check whether customs action is actually required.

explanation: Expected parcels make delivery scams especially convincing. The tracking route you already have is the safest source of truth.
